spec_text:
HAZELNUT VISUAL QA SPECIFICATION  HZ-QA-07 rev C
Part: whole in-shell hazelnut, nominal width 20 mm, inspected top-down on a dark conveyor by a camera inspector.

3. ACCEPTABLE (do not reject)
3.1 Natural shell colour variation, longitudinal stripes and gloss.
3.2 The rough, fuzzy cap (hilum) area and its natural boundary.
3.3 Small natural specks, dust shadows and lighting gradients.

4. REJECT
4.1 Hole: any drilled, bored or insect hole through the shell, any diameter. Typically 0.5-2 mm, dark inside, with a rough or torn rim.
4.2 Crack: any fracture of the shell, from a thin hairline split to a broken-away piece exposing the kernel.
4.3 Cut: any knife cut, slice or notch in the shell surface, usually straight-edged and 2-8 mm long, showing paler material inside.
4.4 Print: any ink, stamp, printed characters or marking on the shell, any size or colour.

5. Inspection must catch every reject class above at the smallest size listed.

defects.description: a tiny circular dark brown-black hollow about one-fortieth to one-tenth of the part width with a rough torn light tan rim and dark shadowed interior
a thin jagged dark brown split in the glossy tan shell running from a hairline to nearly the full part width with rough fractured edges exposing matte pale kernel where wide
defects.severity_note: any fracture, from thin hairline split to broken-away piece exposing the kernel

defects.description: a straight-edged pale beige slice about one-tenth to nearly half the part width with clean sharp sides and smooth matte paler interior contrasting the glossy brown shell
defects.severity_note: any knife cut, slice or notch, usually 2-8 mm long

defects.description: a small flat matte black-blue stamped character mark about one-tenth of the part width on the glossy tan shell with crisp inky lettering texture

Add a tiny circular dark brown-black hollow about one-fortieth to one-tenth of the part width with a rough torn light tan rim and dark shadowed interior exactly at the center of the image. The defect must be small and local, covering well under a tenth of this image, with the rest of the part intact. Keep the same lighting, focus, texture and camera angle. Do not change anything else in the photo.

hole: caught at every size tested (down to 0.2x (~0.3 mm)); contrast: holds to 0.5x, missed at 0.25x (0/3)
print: size: holds to 0.35x (~0.46 mm), missed at 0.2x (~0.26 mm) (1/3); contrast: holds to 0.25x, missed at 0.12x (0/3)
